predecessors.name: Zhou dynasty
predecessors.text: Shen, 'Its capital stood in Wan County (宛县)', Nanyang, Henan; the chu dossier draws the same disc for its 688 gain

successors.name: Chu
successors.text: Shen, 'Its capital stood in Wan County (宛县)', Nanyang, Henan; the chu dossier draws the same disc for its 688 gain

ledger.x: 821: the cadet state of Southern Shen is founded near Nanyang.
688: the state of Shen ends in Chu's conquest; it became 'an important northern county' of Chu.

wars.name: Shen-Zeng-Quanrong sack of the Zhou capital
wars.outcome: The rebel Marquis of Shen, with Zeng and the Quanrong, defeated King You's army at Mount Li in 771 BC and sacked Fenghao; the king was killed and the court moved east.

wars.name: Chu conquest of Shen
wars.outcome: King Wen of Chu sent an army against Shen in 688 BC and annexed it as a county; Chu then reached across the Nanyang Basin (the Deng page adds that Deng fell in 678).

certainty.note: No Shen boundary is on the pages; soft throughout.
